This fruit plot is very small, and I mix crops on it, so I will manage it with what my family can do by hand. I do not have much money for chemical inputs, so I will use manure or compost if I can get it, keep using the local planting material I know, and rely mostly on family work. I will not hire workers for such a small plot, and I will only use water if rain is not enough, but for this season I am not planning irrigation.
